svg.title: Autocollimator surface alignment
svg.desc: An unfolded ray diagram shows a reticle point at the objective focal plane becoming a collimated bundle. A tilted mirror returns the bundle at twice its tilt, and the objective focuses a displaced image.
svg.text: Autocollimation converts surface tilt into image displacement

g.data-original-text: <text x="315" y="365" text-anchor="middle" class="l">objective, focal length f_a</text>
g.title: objective, focal length f_a

g.data-original-text: <text x="967.5" y="342" text-anchor="middle" class="l">Delta x = 2 f_a tau</text>
g.title: Delta x = 2 f_a tau

svg.text: Objective: angle to position. Reflection: surface tilt tau to beam angle 2 tau.
